items.title: Will Shipley: Questionable to return Sunday
items.text:
Shipley (foot) is questionable to return to Sunday's game versus the Jaguars in London.

items.title: Jordan Addison: Looks poised to sit Sunday
items.text:
Addison (hamstring), who is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Saints, is expected to be inactive for the contest, Jeff Darlington of ESPN reports.

items.title: Lamar Jackson: 'Real chance' at Week 6 return
items.text:
Jackson (ankle), who has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Falcons, has a "real chance" to return to action next week against Cleveland, pending how he responds to rehab, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.
